place.name: The whole world (coarse)
place.sources: The world: SRTM/GMTED2010 on land, ETOPO1 on the sea (Tilezen data-sources.md, low zooms); public domain (USGS, NOAA)

attribution: Terrain: SRTM/GMTED2010/3DEP courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey; ETOPO1 NOAA
Terrain tiles: Mapzen/Tilezen Terrarium via the AWS Open Data registry (registry.opendata.aws/terrain-tiles)
licence: SRTM, GMTED2010, 3DEP (USGS) and ETOPO1 (NOAA) are public domain; other regions carry their own lines (tilezen/joerd docs/attribution.md). Shown on screen, never behind a click.

despiked.rule: a pixel more than 400 m off the median of its 8 neighbours takes the median (source spikes), repeated to a fixed point; the tile is re-encoded
